Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Uh oh, looks like I just found the . . . “party cabin!” All the beds are broken, the dresser is knocked over, and there’s a huge axe stuck in the wall. Plus, there’s a pile of all the non-foil cards from the Camp Totally Safe Superdrop! It looks like somebody had a great time in here. I hope we party like this while we’re here at Camp Totally Safe.
